hooks.name: Landing Page Consistency Sync
hooks.description: Tracks file edits for cross-page consistency (IDE only, skipped on spot)

action.command: bash -c '[ "$KIRO_SPOT" = "1" ] && exit 0; echo "CONSISTENCY CHECK: 1. Log the edited file path. 2. If file is root index.html - check if for-physios/index.html and for-clinics/index.html need similar nav/footer updates. 3. If file is css/styles.css - check if for-physios/css/styles.css and for-clinics/css/styles.css need the same changes. 4. If file is privacy.html or terms.html - check if sub-landing versions need updates. Response: Logged: {filepath} + any sync recommendations."'
